summary: Probably John's 3rd cousin 4x removed; Hunlock Creek lumber baron and 25-year justice of the peace.
bio: Hiram Croop (b. 1832), 'a grandson of both John Croop and Philip Sorber', once ran four mills and owned 2,000 acres of timber; justice of the peace for 25 years; store at Croop's mills.
